criteria.description: Exclusively adults, animals, or conditions other than bronchiolitis.
Non-invasive positive-pressure ventilation, including continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) and NIPPV.
No non-invasive positive-pressure ventilation comparator; conventional low-flow oxygen alone is ineligible.
Non-randomized studies, duplicate publications, reviews, conference abstracts, and case reports. A related trial report must not be deemed duplicate solely because it concerns the same trial.
Published from inception through May 2022, without language restrictions.
Clearly published after May 2022; a year-only 2022 date is insufficient to establish exclusion.
At least one of treatment failure as defined by the trial, need for intubation, or pediatric intensive care unit length of stay.
Confirmed absence of all eligible outcomes. Missing outcome information in title/abstract alone is insufficient for exclusion.

notes: 依据用户指定的 DE V3 Zhong Protocol Source 投影；May 2022 规范化为月末。题录由用户外部提供，本 Run 不执行或验证原检索。标题摘要缺少信息不构成明确排除；不读取 Review 结果或 Benchmark Reference。
research_question: In children with bronchiolitis, how does high-flow nasal cannula compare with non-invasive positive-pressure ventilation for treatment failure, need for intubation, and pediatric intensive care unit length of stay?
title: High-flow nasal cannula versus non-invasive positive-pressure ventilation in children with bronchiolitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis protocol
